Historical May averages near 33–34°C, combined with the narrow window for intensification before the wet season fully sets in, explain the concentration around these values while allowing modest probability for brief surges or suppression by showers. Updated model runs in the coming days will refine steering patterns and precipitation timing ahead of resolution.
